caption: The drawing depicts a small pouch or bag with a drawstring closure at the top. The drawstring is pink with lighter stripes and forms loops on either side of the bag. The upper portion of the bag is a solid light tan color, likely representing fabric. Below this, there is a decorative band with a repeating triangular pattern in green, red, and blue, bordered by thin yellow stripes. The central section of the bag is elaborately decorated with a needlepoint or beaded floral design; it includes red, pink, blue, and yellow flowers with green leaves on a light blue to grey background, all arranged in a horizontal stripe. Below the floral section is another horizontal band consisting of dense red, blue, and white geometric or floral motifs. The bottom edge of the bag is adorned with a fringe made up of long, loose hanging loops. The background of the image is a plain, off-white or beige paper, and the drawing is rendered with visible pen outlines and colored washes.
title: Bag
